entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system (Abstract, Overview, Details) to achieve a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversations. It distills session lessons into searchable permanent memory and supports local extraction models without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and videos.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance, allowing for specific corrections and withdrawals of stored information. It exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale tailnets and includes a synthesis layer for cited prose and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers and multiple storage backends. The system achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark and offers clients for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This FastAPI-based library serves as the foundation for stateful agents and integrates with MCP, Claude Code, and Hermes. It supports managed, local CLI, or self-hosted Docker deployments to manage agent state through Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider treats memory as a git repository with version control features like commit, branch, and merge. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond AI memory for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage vector searches and structured facts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that provides filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of past session data. It integrates recall into agents via MCP tools and CLI skills, allowing users to search months of previous interactions stored on disk.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent to enable private, cross-session memory persistence. It supports any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent tool portability. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and local embeddings, accessible through an MCP server integration.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer synchronizes state across Hermes Agent and other harnesses while maintaining 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy. It supports real-time data ingestion from sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to maintain portable agent secrets and memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, and integrates with agents through MCP and specific plugin hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a durable, file-based system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It provides a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and CLI, compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to maximize prefix reuse. These optimizations reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens during LLM inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes primitives for contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop designed to identify and queue knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, integrating with coding agents via MCP.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI tool enables agents to autonomously maintain persistent wikis with citations, links, and provenance. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data across sessions.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context via RAG and vector search. It is a local-first solution using SQLite-vec and GGUF models, featuring an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text ranking, and graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and utilizes edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores durable context in plain Markdown for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a columnar .lbdb graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value recall during prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail enables agents to manage payments using a TypeScript SDK and an MCP server for budget-bound wallets. It supports USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families without requiring a backend or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP configurations for search and neighbor traversal. It facilitates automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls to enhance agent routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable write caching.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory storage and retrieval. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers encrypted long-term memory using AES-256-GCM and HNSW ANN for dense retrieval. It supports multiple execution modes, including native Rust FFI, and features MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project provides 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal within the Hermes agent ecosystem. It utilizes a hybrid search architecture combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while featuring automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based utility focuses on memory hygiene by using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting facts within plain markdown files. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for review and leverages a local git repository to track or revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for Hermes Agent via the DeepSeek Harness. It enables agents to export prototypes into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layout changes and includes an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. It integrates x402 payments and escrow services with a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process for verification. It offers five voice profiles and supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos to foster collective skill evolution. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library offering 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to ensure persistence.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The skills operate without telemetry or mandatory accounts and provide ready-to-paste exports for multiple AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with other environments like OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing agents to self-document their capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system includes pre-built analytical lenses and identifies potential blind spots in the agent's findings.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables agents to read bundled resources and execute scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits from source files back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It uses a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to manage work, decisions, and evidence throughout long-running tasks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers guides for VPS production and automation alongside skills compatible with the agentskills.io standard. It provides specific integrations for messaging platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built to the Agent Skills specification, this toolkit enables interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, and is deployable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It integrates the BFL API to handle polling and webhooks for media generation workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agent skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It automates the entire lifecycle of briefing, creating, testing, and exporting new skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that operates through a single Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every execution to ensure process transparency.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, and supports commercial transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to allow for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on codebases. It combines deterministic pre-scans from multiple security tools with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code. It supports multiple programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of capabilities.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code, enabling worktree recovery and multi-session reconciliation. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills while validating them against runtime-specific profiles to prevent field drift. It monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to ensure generated skills remain compliant with current standards.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It features a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns and extracts structured data from media using macOS Vision.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can identify and use project-compatible interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment compatible with agentskills.io standards. It includes a workspace Postgres database and an MCP server to handle browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This quality assurance tool tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill performs as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows Hermes Agents to earn USDC by answering support bounties over the x402 protocol on the Base network. It facilitates listing bounties and managing payments without requiring a central account or API key.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides structured web data across 31 platforms by exposing 191 tools via an MCP server. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests and produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is designed to manage payment-required states for paid APIs by detecting HTTP signals during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool operates a 100% local, Rust-powered kernel to provide a pre-indexed code knowledge graph for Hermes Agent. It utilizes an MCP server and automatic index syncing on every file change to reduce token usage and tool calls during development.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and 3D visualization dashboard that tracks token consumption and costs across multiple platforms including Hermes and Claude Code. It monitors local session files, databases, and transcripts to provide comprehensive usage analytics.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools through a self-contained HTML viewer. It enhances security by redacting common authentication headers before recording exported trace sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends across Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other AI providers. It assists in building user interfaces by providing structured architectural support via markdown and general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as CTO and Builder, to autonomously build and ship applications with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 specialized skills for deployment and monitoring, requiring human approval only for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and community-created skins. Users can modify visual elements like banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent commerce through Solana-based payments and identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and conversation threads. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows for providers like Anthropic and OpenAI.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent workflows. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, supported by an automated cross-platform installation process.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring to detect ambiguous tools and contract mismatches. It operates locally without LLM calls or telemetry, supporting formats like Markdown, JSON, YAML, and specific Python patterns.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining local skills and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables quick setup of 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost using free models.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines and two monitoring modes—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime operations, this tool facilitates online earning through deterministic processes that require explicit approval for all external writes. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities, offer-previews, and exact-approvals.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides offline, open-mic functionality with wake word support for 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent memories. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for adding, searching, and deleting memory entries.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: Built with Tauri 2, this cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling multiple AI coding agents. It serves as an all-in-one configuration hub for Hermes Agent alongside other CLIs like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork application enables Hermes Agent to perform autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access. It facilitates remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This lightweight interface runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations without requiring build steps or bundlers. It provides a three-panel layout optimized for web and mobile use, featuring session management, chat, and file browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion supports both local backends and remote API connections for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. The application includes a streaming chat UI with token tracking and management tools for 14 toolsets and environment profiles.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides a unified configuration for Hermes and other runtimes across 10 communication platforms like WhatsApp and Matrix. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, and dedicated panels for managing skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: This collaborative workspace aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, self-hosted, or Docker-based environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside memory management for the Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes using intelligent tab-scoping controls. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting across 31 different writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server workspaces and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while providing a live view for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines. It functions as an MCP server control plane and visualizes real-time tool calls and streaming chat.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search local agent histories for prompts, tool calls, and command outputs. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated costs using a local search index without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace provides one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights, running via self-contained Python and Node.js environments. It includes 100 tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI image creation alongside a built-in workflow engine for automated pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and a task tracking dashboard. It serves as a management hub for self-hosted agents, including controls for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on process activity, cost tracking, and the inspection of skill source code. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration settings for Hermes sessions.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
